title: Replace character from the approved still
description: The video step after the still is approved: the approved still is the first frame, the clip's own skeleton is the motion, and each person is painted back over the clean clip through their own mask so the wall, the microphone and the light stay the source's pixels. One window of 81 frames (3.4 s at 24 fps). Meant for a clip already made clean and for a still the user has approved.

evidence: 2026-10-27 (0.1.0): the graph is the reviewed local-jutsu one-window shape (native-workflows/local-jutsu-replace) with the Klein anchor pass removed: the approved still is the reference image and the clip's SDPose skeleton is the motion. One real render of that shape ran on the user's clip and still: 81 frames, 1206x904, 24 fps, 437 s at 23.1 GB, and the composite keeps the wall, the microphone and the light. That render exposed two defects: SDPose draws one person, so the second person stays on the still's pose, and the left person's head is missing from the render. The shipped graph therefore poses each person separately through their own SAM 3 mask; that change is wired and has NOT been run, because the local ComfyUI's HTTP server stopped answering after the first render and never came back. The two-person pose pass is not qualified: it is wired, not run. Honest checks, frames and the experiment log: docs/REPLACE-ANCHOR.md, docs/REPLACE-ANCHOR-EXPERIMENTS.md and docs/evidence/replace-from-still/.
